# 🦜 Owny's Parrot Breeder [1.19+]

[![View on GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Owny/ParrotBreeder?label=GitHub&logo=github)](https://github.com/Owny/ParrotBreeder)

---

![Parrots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07b7bf030daa9ea8ee9173a7bde55437e6d91d48.gif)
Breed parrots like other animals — using any kind of seed!

---

## ✅ Features

- Breed parrots using any **vanilla seed**:
  - Wheat Seeds
  - Melon Seeds
  - Pumpkin Seeds
  - Beetroot Seeds
- ❤️ Cute particle effects when breeding
- ⚡ Lightweight and lag-free
- 🔧 No configuration needed

---

## 🧪 How to Use

1. Tame two parrots (optional).
2. Feed each one **any seed**.
3. They enter **love mode**.
4. A **baby parrot** appears!

Works exactly like other animal breeding!

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

- Minecraft: `1.19+`
- Servers: `Spigot`, `Paper`, `Purpur`
- ❌ Not compatible with: `Forge` or `Fabric`

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR from [Hangar](https://hangar.papermc.io/).
2. Place it in your server's `/plugins/` folder.
3. Restart or reload the server.
4. Done — enjoy breeding parrots!
